description: This file defines a custom UI component CategorySectionView for an Android application. It manages displaying a category section with a header, a list of products, and handles loading/error states. It also supports interacting with cart actions and navigation to see all products.

classes.name: CategorySectionView
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout that displays a category section with a header, a horizontally scrolling list of products, and loading/error states. Handles interactions such as 'See All' and cart operations.

methods.name: setCartCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback functions for cart interactions such as adding, incrementing, or decrementing product quantities.

methods.name: bindHeader
methods.description: Binds the category header with title and icon, and sets the callback for the 'See All' button.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Shows or hides a loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message when data fails to load.

methods.name: submitItems
methods.description: Updates the list of products displayed in the section.
